text: The Imperial Legion marched a picked company out of Castle Dour toward the old house near Falkreath that served the Dark Brotherhood for a sanctuary, there to break the brotherhood of killers who had taken Maven Black-Briar's contract against the Emperor's toll-officers, and to seize their contract-books before another name on the seized ledgers could be crossed off.
